accroche.en: I want to buy ten refurbished phones to resell in my shop.
accroche.fr: Je veux acheter dix téléphones reconditionnés pour les revendre dans ma boutique.

dialogue.en: Hello. I want ten refurbished phones to resell in my shop.
Which brand? I have Samsung and Tecno.
Samsung. What is the battery health?
Above 85 percent. All phones are unlocked.
Can I test three phones before I pay?
What is your price for ten, with the original box?
55,000 CFA each without box, 58,000 CFA with the original box.
I will take ten without box. Please give me a receipt and a three months warranty.

pratique_micro: Can I test the phones before I pay?
Please give me a receipt and a warranty.

defi.en: Buy five phones to resell. Ask about battery health, testing, the original box, the price for five and the warranty.
defi.fr: Achète cinq téléphones à revendre. Demande l'état de la batterie, le test, la boîte d'origine, le prix pour cinq et la garantie, en anglais.

evaluation.q: What does 'unlocked' mean for a phone?
How do you ask to check the phone before paying?
choix: Can I test it before I pay?
evaluation.reponse: Can I test it before I pay?

evaluation.q: I want to buy ten phones to ___ in my shop.

recap: Tu sais acheter des téléphones à revendre, vérifier la batterie, tester avant de payer et exiger un reçu et une garantie.
